And I'm curious to see if we get that late week drop. And I'm not being bearish or spreading foot or anything like that. I will say right now, ADA is actually pushing against that 50-day moving average. We obviously talked about the resistance that lies here. It looks like, again, there is a fair value gap just above here. So ADA might be trying to get get up to this range potentially close that only time will tell but btc right now is again fighting structure we're just above that 71-1 level we're trying to see if we're going to again turn this into more green or will we yet again face some rejection and test the bottom of our trends like we've seen many times before i will say btc dominance is still hanging within range still floating you know between 58 and 60 percent has just been chopping here since November so there hasn't been a lot of variation here again it looks like a lot of the capitulation got out of the way early so right now you're just watching basically the entire crypto market move around with with each other now here's the thing is I saw this this update by the Khabisi letter yesterday. I thought this was a really good point. They said, we firmly believe there are ongoing US-Iran peace talks right now. Why? Because we've seen this exact sequence of events multiple times in previous deals negotiated by Trump, which is true. We've seen it's kind of like a delayed fuse. There's a lot of backdoor stuff going on while there's this essentially posturing taking place on the public side, on the media side. And that's why, again, you know, we don't know who's telling the truth. We don't know what's actually taking place. And we don't know what the outcome will be until it's actually announced by both sides. Now, there were a few updates over the last 24 hours here. The U.S. officially sends Iran a 15-point ceasefire proposal, which was mediated by Pakistan. We're also seeing a preliminary list of Iran's demande for a potential ceasefire with the U.S. and Israel, and this has been compiled. The terms include reparations and compensation for wartime losses. Iran obtains formal control of the Strait of Hormuz security guarantees against future military action and number four no limitation on Iran's ballistic missile program so it sounds like the two are going to be very far apart at least initially in these negotiations and again maybe it's closer uh behind the scenes but obviously this is something that gave us green yesterday was this floated ceasefire by the U.S. for a potential month. And obviously oil prices dropped on that. Let's see where they're at right now. Oil prices are—U.S. oil is down 1.78% for the day so far. Gold and silver are up, and it's not really surprising because, again, there's still major uncertainty around the world. And this was the big announcement just a few minutes ago. Iran's military chiefs have rejected with US military chiefs are out of date and still have huge uncertainty remains. And yeah, that's, again, just the place that we're living in right now is uncertainty. Now, another big update from the last 24 hours is this. Earn rewards through activity allowed. Earn yield just for holding banned. And that's very disappointing. Obviously, a lot of people were earning yield. Obviously, the banks felt that it hurt them. And this is an unfortunate concession that we're seeing in the clarity act. It does move, obviously, the clarity act one step closer to being signing into law. And it obviously can open up the door for much bigger adoption. But it's definitely a disappointing advancement. Nonetheless, I'm sure many people will agree with me on that. So now we have to just watch and wait and see how the day plays out. I will say one thing I really wanted to mention is we are actually seeing open interest on the rise. We're up 7.49% to 112 billion just over the last 24 hours here. And what this actually marks is the highest amount of leverage in the space, obviously since March 17th, but more so since the. Since January. All right. So we are watching people get a little bit more comfortable in the markets. Uh, the betters, the traders are getting a little bit more comfortable doing their training because the market is. Just a little bit more volatile. I will say things have kind of dialed down over the last 24 hours we've seen volume actually dropped down to 95 billion after it was elevated to 130 billion just the other day so market's still still waiting to make a more uh more defined move if you will we're still in a state of fear we haven't escaped that yet there's still uncertainty floating around the crypto space, but obviously there's progress being made on all fronts. We did get some of the PMI data yesterday. PMI was elevated. What is it? Manufacturing costs are up as well. So that's obviously not good. That's going to put probably more pause in what the Fed decides to do, but that's kind of where we're at guys we're still in an uncertain place we still have a lot of progress to make and we'll just have to wait and see what happens but I appreciate you guys I hope you enjoyed the video let me know your thoughts below but have a great day catch you guys in the next one take care
